scene.speaker: freya
scene.bubble: The park after school: the slide, the swings, the big tree… and one hour of pure fun!
scene.intro: The park after school is the best place in the world. Freya goes up the slide and comes down very fast. Nico is on the swing, higher and higher. There is a big old tree with birds, there are flowers next to the bench, and the grass is soft and green. Let's play hide and seek! says Freya. One, two, three… Where can YOU play near your house? Let's go to the park!

words.clue: You go up the stairs and come down fast!

Big and green. Birds live in it.
Green and soft under your feet.

data.voice_note: Voces: Freya y Nico (tarde de parque).
data.script: Freya: The park! I love the red slide. … Nico: I'm on the swing! Higher, higher! … Freya: Look, five little birds in the big tree. … Nico: And Pip is talking to them. Bird meeting! … Freya: Let's have our snack on the grass. … Nico: Apples and biscuits. Perfect! … Freya: One more time on the slide before home? … Nico: Ten more times!

data.title: A story about playing
data.intro: What is the book about? What is the song about? Say the action with -ing.
data.can: I can say what a story is about: a story about playing in the park.

examples.text: This is a story about playing football.
This is a story about playing in the park.

rules: about + verb + -ing: about playing, about singing, about eating.
Never "a story about play". The verb always takes -ing here.
Tell your partner: "My favourite book is about ___ing."
